# Generated by tools/ranking.py - the Great Powers panel is recounted once a month (WLD, the wilds, always exists)
on_actions = {
	on_startup = {
		effect = {
			if = { limit = { tag = WLD } ANTE_update_ranking = yes }
		}
	}
	on_monthly = {
		effect = {
			if = { limit = { tag = WLD } ANTE_update_ranking = yes }
		}
	}
}
